findings.description: Direct admission does not enforce application ownership of created_at. Preparing a valid event and changing only created_at to another timezone-aware timestamp leaves every DERIVED field unchanged. validate_admission explicitly copies the supplied timestamp into its expected event and compares only DERIVED, so Repository.put accepts and permanently retains the forged import time. The JSON-input rejection test does not cover this direct model-copy path required by Plan criteria 8-9.

The privacy assertion serializes seed_review's boundary-case, whose intent and media are unrelated to the TEST-ONLY resolution fixtures. A serializer that incorrectly exposes resolutions belonging to the serialized case would still pass because this case has none. No pairwise submission is made, so the revealed results branch is also untested. This does not prove Plan criterion 10's public/embed omission requirement.
